name: Mornington Peninsula Beach Club Cottages
signature: Five two-bedroom bay-beach cottages in Tootgarook with EV charging, disability access, and private yards — eight minutes from Peninsula Hot Springs
editorNote:
Five two-bedroom cottages 200 metres from the bay beach in Tootgarook, with private yards, disability-access features, and EV charging installed. Pet- and family-friendly. Eight minutes to Peninsula Hot Springs — a combination that makes this a practical base for a thermal weekend without the resort price tag.

The disability-access provision is notable in a category that mostly does not address it. Confirm specific access features if relevant before booking.
whyWeGo: Bay beach, private yards, EV charging, disability access — the most practically equipped family and accessibility-friendly cottage option on the Peninsula.
ifOnlyOneThing: Confirm EV charging specifications and disability-access features before booking if either is relevant.
dogFriendlyNotes: Pet-friendly with private yards. Confirm breed, size, and unattended-dog policy before booking.
